stories.title: Andy Burnham faces fiscal scrutiny in first PMQs
stories.details: In his first Prime Minister's Questions, Andy Burnham attempted to calm markets following a surge in borrowing costs. He emphasized a commitment to fiscal responsibility while ruling out further tax hikes or borrowing in the upcoming budget.

stories.title: UK mortgage rates expected to rise
stories.details: Global bond sell-offs have pushed UK swap rates to their highest levels since late 2023. Property experts warn that lenders will likely increase fixed-term mortgage rates to manage risk, potentially undermining efforts to ease the cost of living.

stories.title: Just Stop Oil protests return to Parliament Square
stories.details: The activist group Just Stop Oil has brought traffic to a standstill in London as they relaunch their campaign against new oil and gas licenses. The protest coincides with broader economic anxiety regarding energy prices.

stories.title: Reform UK bans journalists from conference
stories.details: The political party Reform UK has barred three journalists from attending their upcoming conference. The decision follows reports of critical coverage regarding the party's recent activities.

stories.title: Tobias Ellwood calls for justice over nuclear scandal
stories.details: Tobias Ellwood has publicly addressed his role in inadvertently misleading Parliament regarding a British nuclear scandal. He is now advocating for transparency and justice in the matter.

stories.title: Israel seeks Trump's support for Gaza expulsion plan
stories.details: Reports suggest Israel is lobbying the Trump administration to back a plan involving the expulsion of Palestinians from Gaza. This comes amid ongoing tensions in the region.

stories.title: US strikes in Iran kill wedding guests
stories.details: A US-led missile strike in southern Iran reportedly hit a wedding, killing at least five people, including a child. A visual analysis confirmed the bomb used was of American origin.

stories.title: Zelenskyy furious over Kyiv spy shootout
stories.details: President Zelenskyy has condemned a shootout between different branches of Kyiv's intelligence services. He described the incident as 'shameful' given the current wartime context.

stories.title: Xi Jinping visits Egypt to challenge US influence
stories.details: Chinese President Xi Jinping made his first visit to Egypt in a decade. The trip is viewed as a strategic move to expand Chinese influence in the Middle East at the expense of the US.

stories.title: Joshua Wong pleads guilty in Hong Kong
stories.details: Prominent pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to charges of colluding with Western lawmakers. He now faces a potential life sentence in prison.

stories.title: Anthropic unveils Fable and Mythos 5.1
stories.details: Anthropic has released updated versions of its AI models. Fable 5.1 is designed to reduce token costs and false-positive safety blocks, while the more restricted Mythos 5.1 remains available only to select partners in science and cybersecurity.

stories.title: Uber lays off 10% of workforce
stories.details: Uber is cutting approximately 3,300 jobs globally, representing 10% of its staff. The move aims to streamline management layers and consolidate operations into fewer regional hubs.

stories.title: Google launches AI-powered 'Google Pics'
stories.details: Google has introduced an AI-based image creation tool to compete with Canva and Adobe Express. The tool allows business users to generate and edit visual content using prompts.

stories.title: OpenAI limits Astra's cybersecurity capabilities
stories.details: OpenAI has paused the development of its 'Astra' model after it demonstrated the ability to autonomously exploit software vulnerabilities. The company is implementing new safeguards before a limited public release.

stories.title: Waymo criticizes camera-only autonomous driving
stories.details: Waymo has argued that camera-only systems, such as those used by Tesla, are insufficient for safe robotaxi operations. The company maintains that a combination of lidar, radar, and cameras is essential.

stories.title: Transfer window closes with record spending
stories.details: The summer transfer window has shut with Premier League spending reaching nearly £3.5bn. Notable late drama included a collapsed £40m deal for Folarin Balogun to join Everton.

stories.title: Sunderland wins tug-of-war for Malick Fofana
stories.details: Sunderland secured the signing of Belgian winger Malick Fofana after a high-stakes competition with Crystal Palace. Both clubs had private jets waiting at the airport to finalize the deal.

stories.title: Katie Taylor's final open workout
stories.details: Boxing legend Katie Taylor held her final open workout, offering fans a glimpse of her preparation and legacy. The event drew significant attention ahead of her upcoming bout.

stories.title: Marco Giampaolo sacked by Cremonese
stories.details: Cremonese has dismissed head coach Marco Giampaolo despite a 2-0 victory over Parma in the Coppa Italia. The club cited a need for a change in direction following poor league form.

stories.title: Richarlison linked with Trabzonspor move
stories.details: Tottenham Hotspur are reportedly prepared to sell Brazilian forward Richarlison if Trabzonspor increases their informal offer. The club is looking to offload players to balance their squad.

stories.title: Gianni Infantino calls for ceasefire in Ukraine
stories.details: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has urged G20 leaders to implement a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine for the duration of the World Cup. The request has drawn mixed reactions regarding its feasibility.

stories.title: Tiger Woods banned from driving
stories.details: Tiger Woods has been banned from driving for five years and fined $1,000 following a reckless driving charge related to a car crash in Florida. The golfer pleaded no contest to the charge.

stories.title: US Open 2026: Sabalenka and Tiafoe advance
stories.details: Aryna Sabalenka, Frances Tiafoe, and Ben Shelton have all advanced to the next round of the US Open. The tournament continues to draw large crowds in New York.

stories.title: Leandro Paredes ponders international retirement
stories.details: Following Lionel Messi's decision to step away from international duty, Leandro Paredes has suggested he may also retire from the Argentina squad. He cited the impact of his recent 10-match suspension.

stories.title: Germany team departs for World Cup
stories.details: The German national football team has officially departed Frankfurt for the World Cup. The squad's travel arrangements have been a point of interest for fans and media alike.

stories.title: Nepal glacier collapse causes massive flooding
stories.details: Deadly flash floods in Nepal were triggered by the collapse of a glacier, likely caused by weakened bedrock. Satellite imagery and 3D models have been used to visualize the disaster.

stories.title: Urine test detects bladder cancer
stories.details: A new urine test, 'Galeas Bladder', has shown a 90% accuracy rate in detecting bladder cancer. The test could significantly speed up diagnosis and reduce the need for invasive procedures.

stories.title: Global warming target missed
stories.details: The UN has announced that the world has failed to limit global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels. A new, more urgent target has been set by the organization.

stories.title: Gene-edited hypoallergenic dogs created
stories.details: A US biotech startup has used CRISPR technology to create gene-edited beagles that do not produce the protein responsible for common dog allergies. The development has sparked ethical debates.

stories.title: Arctic habitat threatened by global heating
stories.details: Research indicates that global heating is threatening the Arctic habitat, leading to more ice loss rather than the expected stability. Scientists are monitoring the region's changing ecosystem.
